About this demo
Synthetic Bricksurance SE data, illustrative event footprints. Not a live operational system. Exposure is computed by governed Unity Catalog functions on real Databricks geospatial SQL.

Exposure & Event Response

Which insured properties are threatened by an active catastrophe — right now, across borders.

Bricksurance SE
What am I seeing?
An event footprint (the wildfire perimeter, flood extent or storm swath) laid over the insured property book. For the selected event and buffer, the workbench asks the governed function fn_exposure_in_footprint which properties fall within 50 / 100 / 200 m of the footprint, measured in true metres (EPSG:3035). The map, the KPIs and the table are all the same governed numbers — nothing is computed in the browser. A single event can span countries, so the country breakdown shows the whole cross-border exposure at once.

How Exposure & Event Response works

Deterministic engines measure; the picture is one governed source of truth.

1
Trust the data

The insured property book (3_property) carries a geocoded location for every exposure — the same policy spine the rest of the estate uses.

2
Find the footprint

An event footprint (2_event_footprint) arrives from a hazard feed — wildfire perimeter, flood extent, storm swath. Multi-segment events are unioned into one shape.

3
Measure the exposure

The governed function fn_exposure_in_footprint intersects properties against the footprint using Databricks geospatial SQL (ST_DWithin) in EPSG:3035, so 50/100/200 m are true metres — inside the footprint counts as 0 m.

4
See it whole — across borders

fn_event_exposure_summary rolls the same rows up by band and by country, so one event shows its entire cross-border exposure in a single view — no country silos.

5
Net of treaty, and by coverholder

fn_gross_to_net turns the threatened sum insured into a modelled loss (ref_damage_factor) and cedes it through the Property Cat XL tower to a net retained figure; fn_exposure_by_coverholder splits the same exposure by delegated authority — the gross / net / by-coverholder answer in one governed place.

6
Tell the people who aren't logged in

When an event clears its peril threshold, fn_event_delta works out what's newly threatened since the last look and an event-grouped digest is dispatched to claims, underwriting & exposure management — one alert carrying the whole cross-border picture. Every dispatch is audited in gov_alert_dispatch, and it runs on a schedule with nobody logged in.
